notablePrerequisites:
If Living Lore is in your graveyard, you have not played a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
An opponent is unable to block your creatures.
description:
Cast Living Lore from your hand or graveyard by paying {3}{U}.
Living Lore enters the battlefield, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard.
Move to your combat phase, and deal combat damage with Living Lore.
Living Lore triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and cast Walk the Aeons from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
